تقترئين (form VIII)
# تَقْتَرِئِينَ (taqtariʔīna) /taq.ta.ri.ʔiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَرَأَ (iqtaraʔa)
# تُقْتَرَئِينَ (tuqtaraʔīna) /tuq.ta.ra.ʔiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَرَأَ (iqtaraʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
